other_material_facts.label: material fact
other_material_facts.value: We supply conductors, power cables and other specialised products to large EPC players such as Kalpataru Projects International Limited (formerly known as Kalpataru Power Transmission Limited), Jackson Limited, Warora Kurnool Transmission Limited, K.G.N.

other_material_facts.label: material fact
other_material_facts.value: We operate two key business segments namely: (i) Manufacturing; and (ii) EPC. • Manufacturing: Our Manufacturing segment consists of three key product categories (i) aluminium conductors; (ii) power cables; and (iii) electrical wires.

other_material_facts.label: material fact
other_material_facts.value: We manufacture a wide variety of power cables which are used in electric power distribution substations, industrial applications, communication systems, electrical panels and machine tools.

other_material_facts.label: material fact
other_material_facts.value: We operate two manufacturing facilities located in Howrah, West Bengal with a combined capacity of 40,000 metric tonne (“MT”) of aluminium consumption per year for manufacturing cables and conductors, with an aggregate area of 264,208 sq. ft.

other_material_facts.label: material fact
other_material_facts.value: 249 (i) Pan India (ii) Worldwide Our Chairperson and founder, Purushottam Dass Goel, has experience in the manufacturing of overhead transmission line conductors, various types of cables and continues to provide strategic insights and overall direction to our business based on his experience of understanding customer preferences and demands in the industry in which we operate.

other_material_facts.label: material fact
other_material_facts.value: Our Revenue from Operations grew at a CAGR of 20.43% from Fiscal 2024 to 2026.

other_material_facts.label: material fact
other_material_facts.value: As on the date of this Red Herring Prospectus, we operate two manufacturing facilities in India and four warehouses to support our manufacturing facilities.

other_material_facts.label: material fact
other_material_facts.value: Our ability to provide end-to-end solutions ensures that we can meet the unique demands of each sector while maintaining quality standards.

other_material_facts.label: vertical_integration
other_material_facts.value: In Fiscal 2026, 23.08%2 of the specialised products used in the EPC projects were manufactured by us in-house.

other_material_facts.label: vertical_integration
other_material_facts.value: Similarly, by manufacturing critical products and components in-house, we have developed a reliable and uninterrupted supply chain for our EPC projects, reducing dependency on external vendors and mitigating risks associated with procurement delays or price volatility.

other_material_facts.label: cost_advantage
other_material_facts.value: The integrated operations enhance our project execution capabilities by allowing us to meet product specifications, while deriving cost efficiencies through economies of scale.

other_material_facts.label: distribution_network
other_material_facts.value: As on the date of this Red Herring Prospectus, our electrical wire business is operational in four states in India through our network of approximately 104 distributors.

other_material_facts.label: cost_advantage
other_material_facts.value: This integration allows us to be more cost competitive and time efficient during the bidding process by leveraging our cross-feeding capabilities, resulting in economies of scale.

other_material_facts.label: vertical_integration
other_material_facts.value: Our in-house manufacturing capabilities allows us to significantly reduce lead times and uncertainties associated with external suppliers, enabling faster response times.

other_material_facts.label: certifications
other_material_facts.value: Our Company has received the Underwriter’s Laboratories (Global Safety Certification) Standards certification (“UL Certification”), demonstrating our ability to comply with the stringent safety and regulatory standards required by our clients based in the U.S. and Europe, thereby significantly expanding our market opportunities in both the U.S. and European markets.

other_material_facts.label: certifications
other_material_facts.value: UL certification is widely recognized as a mark of safety, quality, and compliance with industry standards, particularly in the U.S. and Europe, where regulatory requirements for product safety and performance are stringent. • EPC: Our EPC segment consists of six business lines, namely (i) power transmission and distribution, (ii) EHV substation, (iii) re-conductoring with HTLS conductors, (iv) railway electrification, (v) solar power projects, and (vi) water management projects.

other_material_facts.label: cost_advantage
other_material_facts.value: This strategic synergy not only improves cost efficiencies but also strengthens supply chain resilience, enabling us to achieve better economies of scale, maximize profitability, and ensure long-term growth.

other_material_facts.label: certifications
other_material_facts.value: Our manufacturing facilities are subjected to quality control checks, accreditation requirements, and periodic inspections from various regulatory agencies that have issued us product and system certifications.

other_material_facts.label: distribution_network
other_material_facts.value: By leveraging our project execution capabilities, vast experience, and global presence, we are well-positioned to capitalize on these emerging opportunities.

other_material_facts.label: technology_ip
other_material_facts.value: We propose to invest in a e-beam cable curing facility, which will allow us to enhance the quality and efficiency of our cables and also position us among the select few manufacturers utilizing e-beam technology in cable production.

other_material_facts.label: distribution_network
other_material_facts.value: Focus on increasing global presence and entering new markets We have an extensive global presence, across Ghana, Bangladesh, Nepal and Niger.

other_material_facts.label: technology_ip
other_material_facts.value: Pursuant to the revised reporting framework, the Manufacturing segment comprises revenue attributable to all proprietary manufactured products, including products supplied for execution of EPC projects, while the EPC segment comprises revenue attributable to EPC services together with the supply of third-party traded products.

other_material_facts.label: scale
other_material_facts.value: Our diverse product portfolio, coupled with our turnkey solutions, has enabled us to expand our sources of revenue and grow our market share.

other_material_facts.label: technology_ip
other_material_facts.value: HTLS Conductors Aluminium Conductor Fiber Reinforced (“ACFR”) Carbon composite core with unique stranding technology which is a core of innovated high-performance conductor called ACFR.

other_material_facts.label: customer_qualification
other_material_facts.value: We have successfully completed the project of installation of 41.03 MW of unique grid-connected floating solar photovoltaic power plant at Purulia, West Bengal. (f) Water management projects: We are executing a water management project in EPC mode, including development of interception and diversion network with a wastewater treatment facility on a design, build, operation and transfer model along with operation and maintenance after completion of a successful trial run and also a project to ensure functionality of a defunct, partially operative rural water supply scheme.

other_material_facts.label: customer_qualification
other_material_facts.value: Tender team evaluates our credentials against the tender requirements to establish pre-qualification eligibility.

other_material_facts.label: customer_qualification
other_material_facts.value: If we are unable to qualify independently based on our bid credentials, we seek a joint venture partner with necessary expertise to jointly fulfil the pre-qualification criteria.

other_material_facts.label: industry_evidence
other_material_facts.value: Under the new 2022-23 series, India’s real GDP grew from Rs 261.2 trillion in FY23 to Rs 323.1 trillion in FY26, logging a CAGR of 7.4% between FY23 and FY26.

other_material_facts.label: industry_evidence
other_material_facts.value: Going forward, India’s population is projected to expand at a CAGR of 0.8% between 2025 and 2030, and is expected to remain the world’s largest throughout the century In addition to the above, the WPP 2024 reports that in 2024, one in every four people lived in a country that has already peaked in size.

other_material_facts.label: industry_evidence
other_material_facts.value: World Urbanization Prospects 2025 India’s per capita income grew by 6.6% in FY23-26 India’s per capita income, a broad indicator of living standards, grew at a CAGR of 6.6% between FY23 and FY26, from Rs 1,59,557 in FY23 to Rs 193,480 in FY26.

other_material_facts.label: industry_evidence
other_material_facts.value: Public capital outlay has increased nearly 4.2 times, from Rs 2.63 trillion in FY18 to Rs 11.21 Growth driver Description and reasoning trillion in FY26 (BE) and is further budgeted at Rs 12.2 trillion in FY27, reflecting the government’s sustained focus on infrastructure creation and industrial development.

other_material_facts.label: industry_evidence
other_material_facts.value: Source: Budget Documents, Crisil Intelligence 1.7 Power Consumption Power demand to maintain healthy momentum slated to grow at 5-7% CAGR over FY27-31 India's electricity demand has been rising steadily, with a CAGR of ~6% between FY20 and FY24.

other_material_facts.label: industry_evidence
other_material_facts.value: Growth drivers such as the PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana, expansion of electric vehicle charging infrastructure, metro rail projects, smart city initiatives, the Revamped Distribution Sector Scheme (“RDSS”), data centre development and large-scale renewable energy projects, including the Khavda Renewable Energy Park, are expected to contribute to sustained demand for power transmission and distribution products.

other_material_facts.label: industry_evidence
other_material_facts.value: Over the next few years, from FY27 to FY31, power demand is expected to maintain a CAGR of 5-7%, reaching 2,189-2,405 billion units.

other_material_facts.label: industry_evidence
other_material_facts.value: Electricity consumption has grown at a CAGR of 5.0% from FY19 to FY25E In India, electricity consumption pattern across various sectors has exhibited a steady growth trend over the past five years, with the total consumption increasing at a CAGR of 5.0% from FY19 to FY25.

other_material_facts.label: industry_evidence
other_material_facts.value: The industrial sector remains the largest consumer of electricity, accounting for ~40% of the total consumption in FY25, the sector grew at a CAGR of 5% from FY19 to FY25.

other_material_facts.label: industry_evidence
other_material_facts.value: The domestic sector was the second-largest consumer in FY25 and grew at a CAGR of 6%, driven by increasing household demand for electricity.

other_material_facts.label: industry_evidence
other_material_facts.value: The agriculture sector has also witnessed a steady growth in electricity consumption, with a CAGR of 3.4%, although its share in total consumption has remained relatively stable at around 16%.

other_material_facts.label: industry_evidence
other_material_facts.value: The commercial sector has experienced a CAGR of 5.5%, with its share in total consumption remaining around 8%.

overview.business_model: We supply conductors, power cables and other specialised products to large EPC players such as Kalpataru Projects International Limited (formerly known as Kalpataru Power Transmission Limited), Jackson Limited, Warora Kurnool Transmission Limited, K.G.N. We operate two key business segments namely: (i) Manufacturing; and (ii) EPC. • Manufacturing: Our Manufacturing segment consists of three key product categories (i) aluminium conductors; (ii) power cables; and (iii) electrical wires. We manufacture a wide variety of power cables which are used in electric power distribution substations, industrial applications, communication systems, electrical panels and machine tools.
